claim: The T015 acceptance tests were written first and fail because the resource-server dependency and identity implementation are absent.
method: GitHub Actions CI #100 Java quality/unit job 93063490094 and Security dependency job 93063490162; no acceptance change or test skip.
expected: Java compile fails at the intended missing implementation/dependency boundary before T015 source exists; frontend and contract checks remain unaffected.
observed: Java quality/unit failed with missing Spring Security packages and OidcSecurityConfiguration/OidcRoleConverter/OidcRolePolicy symbols; frontend-contract completed successfully. Security dependency resolution reached the same Java test compilation failure. The baseline test also exposed a missing shared RoleCode import, repaired in the next test-only commit.
limitations: This is a tests-first baseline, not runtime security proof.
Security image scans were still in progress at observation time.
The baseline commit did not contain production credentials, tokens, cookies or external IdP access.
